description: This file defines the CustomFieldAPI class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin, providing REST API endpoints for managing custom fields (create, retrieve, update, delete, list) in the Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: CustomFieldAPI
classes.description: API class providing CRUD operations for managing custom fields within the PIM module of OrangeHRM, including endpoints for creating, fetching, updating, deleting, and listing custom fields.

methods.name: getCustomFieldService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the CustomFieldService instance used for business logic operations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific custom field by its ID from the database.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Fetches the ID parameter from the request URL to identify which custom field to operate on.

methods.name: getBodyParameters
methods.description: Extracts relevant parameters (name, type, screen, extraData) from the request body.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getOne' endpoint, ensuring the ID parameter is valid.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all custom fields available, with support for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for list operation, mainly for sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new custom field, enforcing a maximum of 10 fields.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new custom field, including field name, type, screen, and optional extra data.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Defines reusable validation rules for the core fields of custom field creation and update.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing custom field identified by ID, with logic to ensure data integrity and usage constraints.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating an existing custom field.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more custom fields, ensuring they are not currently in use.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for delete operation, primarily verifying the list of IDs.

methods.name: setCustomField
methods.description: Assigns values to a CustomField entity from request parameters.

methods.name: saveCustomField
methods.description: Persists a CustomField entity using the service layer.
